nom: COSRX Oil-Free Ultra-Moisturizing Lotion with Birch Sap

avis.texte: I love this moisurizer. I have sensitive skin & eczema on my face and this has been so helpful! Very light. It is more of a gel texture than a lotion, but i personally like that more.

avis.titre: Best moisturizer I've ever tried for oily skin
avis.texte: I've tried many different moisturizers marketed for oily skin. I love the idea of a gel-cream moisturizer but most have not been moisturizing enough. This one is lightweight and moisturiziing without being too much or too little for my skin. This is my new holy grail!

I'm 46 with combo/dry aging skin. I've used $100.00 K-Beauty moisturizers, Estée Lauder, Lancome, Tatcha, Glow Recipe, etc... I bought the COSRX Oil Free Moisturizer in a pinch and actually like it! I use the Kate Sommerville Eradikate daily cleanser with my PTR Soniclear Elite followed by Mamonde Rose Toner during the day, (Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner at night), Hanskin Essence, Peach and Lily Good Acids Copper Peptides Serum, Kiehl's 🥑 Eye Cream, and the COSRX Moisturizer as my final skincare step. I like how light it is, the price point, the volume of product, the consistency, & how long the bottle lasts. Its travel - friendly and good for all skin types.

This moisturizer is great for the summer or daytime, but personally its too lightweight for my combo skin. Its more hydrating than moisturizing and has a gel like texture. I gave it to my roommate who has oily skin and she loves it

avis.titre: Great Moisturizer for my Combo Skin
avis.texte: It has helped me a lot with managing my breakouts along with clarifying toner. They really are a great combo to use. All the ingredients are clean and i havent had any type of allergic reaction. Ive scanned it the bottle for acnegenic and condemenic ingredients and it had none and then i also scanned it for toxins and it had none. Overall i would recommend to anyone unless they're specifically looking for a matteifying moisturizer. This oil free moisturizer gives you a slight sheen and glow.
New favorite! This has been amazing for my combo skin. My skin stays hydrated all day long but doesn't get oily. Great as a base layer under make-up, doesn't pill.
lightweight moisturizer , made skin smooth , I Don't Think this moisturizer won't break you out !!!
i love this moisturizer, its perfect for layering! especially for skincare routines & when applying spf and makeup

I initally didnt like this mosituriser as the birch smell is a little odd…like a tree. But i reallt liked the lightness and the way it absorbs. So ive gotten use to the scent. This is the perfect day moisturizer as its light and absorbs well. I have dry somewhat sensitive skin. This product hasnt bothered me. I will definitely keep it in my routine

I initally didnt like this mosituriser as the birch smell is a little odd…like a tree. But i reallt liked the lightness and the way it absorbs. So ive gotten use to the scent. This is the perfect day moisturizer as its light and absorbs well. I have dry somewhat sensitive skin. This product hasnt bothered me. I will definitely keep it in my routine

I normally use a $100 moisturizer from Korea, but ran out on vacation and this was the best I could find. I have combo/oily in the tzone. Its pretty lightweight and moisturizes, but I wouldn't depend on it for all of your moisture needs. Its not long lasting. After cleansing I use: Peach and Lily Toner; Hanskin Essence (7x); P&L Glass Skin Serum; this COSRX moisturizer, & Kiehl's Avocado Creamy Eye Treatment.

this is the best mousturizer I've ever tried. I have ridiculously greasy skin and have always struggled with mousturizers enhancing that and being too heavy on my skin, but this one absorbs almost instantly!! my skin feels so healthy and it also reduces the oil somehow? I would recommend this mousturizer 10x over to anyone with oily skin who struggles with these problems.

avis.titre: Better than any high end moisturizer
avis.texte: Keeps my skin hydrate. So easy to apply and a little goes a long way. The price is a steal compared to how good this product is

Got this in combo with their expensive jar cream to try out this lines moisturizers/creams. I will say, I LOVE this stuff. Any type of gel texture type moisturizer, I'm there for. Cream is fine too but more thick and annoying to put on and I don't need it everyday (only on extra dry days). This stuff has a very light earthy scent to it that I like and just feels good to rub in. I don't use it on a daily basis but I should. I just alternate between a lot.

Ive been trying to find something for my oily acne prone skin. I used the peach and lilly. I was okay, but it wasn't moisturizing enough. I saw this and have been wanting to dabble into korean skincare. Let me tell you, it definitely has a smell. Its mo fragrance though. This contains burch sap. So it smells very strong of that when applying, but it doesnt last. If you have really have sensetive slin i would not recommend. Is very moisturizing. A little goes a long way. Still using it, ill try to update when the bottle is empty.

I really wanted to like this moisturizer as someone with combination skin but it just wasnt for me. I would use alot of it and it still left my skin feeling dry and tight. It is not very hydrating or moisturizing at all. It also has an odd smell.

I started using this product 2 months ago and I broke out from it pretty badly. I got a combination of whiteheads and cycstic acne. I have combo skin and i would get really oily with this moisturizer. I wanted to like the product because its oil free. I mostly broke out on my chin and forehead.

This oil free moisturizer is now my daily favorite! It goes on so smoothly and genuinely hydrates my skin. It feels good under makeup as well. I cant use other moisturizers anymore because they clog up my pores.

avis.titre: Hate the Smell, Love the Results
avis.texte: When I first tried this product, I hated the smell and didn't notice any advantage over my regular moisturizer. It went into my "may try again in the future or when desperate," bag. About a year later, I did a light TCA peel. My skin is very oily/combo oily, and can handle a chemical peel well. Normally, I use a few very basic products post peel. We'll, a few days later, accidentally used my AHA BHA toner instead of my hydrating/calming toner. My skin went ballistic: inflamed, textured, and itchy. I immediately purchased a popular Barrier Repair moisturizer to help calm down my skin. All that moisturizer did was give me acne. Cue desperation. Into the bag I went. I found this CosRx moisturizer and gave it a try - first mixing it with pure aloe gel for a week, then using the moisturizer on its own for the next 2 weeks. When I tell you this saved my skin!! I've even used it on my eczema (neck down my skin is bone dry) and it's helping! I still hate the smell; however, this product is now a skincare staple for me.
All other lotions I've tried make my skin oily, or clog my pores. But this one is a game changer!

avis.titre: Holy Grail for Mature / Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: Astounding formulation & feels heavenly on skin. My 50+ skin is STILL very acne prone & flips btwn dry & slightly oily. This ACTUALLY moisturizes & calms my crazy skin. LOVE IT, plus layers REALLY well with other products
I have super sensative skin and this moisturizer soothes it and plums my skin I look so young.

Most moisturizers I have tried that say they are for oily skin just don't work. I am very prone to acne, and about a week after using, I noticed my acne was gone!! If you want some very VERY lightweight hydration, this moisturizer is for you!!
This product still gives of a sheer look after you apply product in a good way. Recommend if you like a little fragrance. Feels light weight.
Was skeptical at first but aftwr putting it on my hand and seeing how nice it felt i had to purchase it, im so glad i did!!

I bought this about a week ago and got unexpected results. I have plaque psoriasis and saw that this calms skin and was on sale. Well I have a few spots on my face and body and it's slowly getting rid of them. I am completely shocked.
Love this product so much! Literally saved my oily dace this summer!!

avis.titre: Yes, I would purchase. Extremely hard to find.
avis.texte: Wonderful clean scent with birch sap. I'd keep around. Almost impossible to reorder.

I have oily acne prone sensitive skin Ive tried this product in my face and throught the day I got so sweaty and at the end of the day I looked like a hydrated glazed donut and you could even see my pores and I got a lot of white heads from the oil. definitely good for dry skin. If you put it into your hands or other parte of your body you would be so soft and its such a nice feeling I also love the scent.

I love this moisturizer. I have extremely oily and acne prone skin. This moisturizer prevents me from looking like a grease ball by the end of the day, and keeps my breakouts calm. Always will be my go to unless they change the formula.
Trust me .. tried it all. Cosrx oil-free moisturizer is the best. Light weight and can be layered with other skincare products. Goes well with retinol.

If you can get past the smell for the first 10 min., this is WORTH IT! I have combination acne prone skin and this oil-free moisturizer provides fantastic lasting hydration without feeling too heavy. Yuka App also rates this a 100/100 Excellent!!

It's amazing! My husband uses it everyday and his skin glows! It's also worth mentioning it's all he uses. I have sensitive/acne prone, dry, aging skin so I use a lot of different products but this is my resting day go-to. It feels so cool and glides on my skin so well and absorbs quickly. Cosrx doesnt add any additional fragrance but the birch sap itself does have a light refreshing scent to it, a very calming, soothing scent in my opinion. And thats what it does to my skin. I'm in love and it's amazing. I will add that once i tried this, i thought I'd like other birch sap products but this is by far the best birch sap product I've found so far. Also, a little goes a long way and i always end up using too much. It's got a lot of slip to it, so a little amount covers a larger service area than you think. Can't say enough about this, and I cant wait to try other Cosrx products.

avis.titre: Holy grail for sensitive, combo skin
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive combination skin. I am also acne prone. My skin is so sensitive that most products immediately inflame and burn my face. The only face lotion that worked with my skin before I found this was the La Roche Posay double repair in matte. The down sides of the double repair were constant pilling (especially towards the end of the bottle and with makeup on) and smaller size (75ml). I was stoked when I saw this lotion in store, as I've loved all COSRX products I've tried. It has surpassed all of my expectations! The smell is really gentle and dissipates quickly. It is so moisturizing and has not caused any irritation or breakouts. There's zero pilling, too! This will be my go to daytime face lotion from now on.

don't listen to the other reviews saying there's fragrance, you can check the ingredients list and there is no fragrance listed! there is a scent to it, a sort of tea tree oil smell but it is pleasant and natural smelling in my opinion. overall i love this moisturizer it feels super hydrating and almost as if there's an oil in it, but it's oil free!!
a little goes a long way and it still makes my skin feel amazing and look glowy
Love this formula! Leaves my skin so smooth. This pairs great with their snail essence.

A good clean moisturizer, helps with pigmentation/uneven tone over time. A non greasy feel, when first using my skin did get a little irritant from fragrance but was low/mild and now I've adapted to it. Last a while get your moneys worth I'm always buying moisturizer never have enough, this has last me a whole year and some change. Not an everyday moisturizer(for me) but a staple fs. Can be worn before makeup without causing weird texture (make sure you allow drying time)

avis.titre: Heavy fragrance triggered immediate allergic reaction
avis.texte: The smell of this lotion is SO intense - more powerful than ever normal highly fragranced cream (this puts Lush, Bath and Bodyworks and The Body Shop to shame), and the most powerful I've ever come across for a face cream. It smells like a full bag of gummy bears! I honestly should have put this down there and then, but curiosity killed the cat (my skin). I loved the texture, how it spread and was gel like and made the skin super dewy and plump. But I could only enjoy that for 10-15 seconds before my eyes started burning and my face got hot and itchy. As a last ditch attempt I used my Tower 28 skin rescue spray and a Laneige cica sleep mask to verify it was not just my skin needing some extra tlc but actually having an allergic reaction. So I immediately had to deep cleanse my entire face and neck with a handy Peach and Lily cleanser sample I had on my sink and put my recovery skin care on instead of my regular routine I had just done before putting this cream on. Unfortunately I learnt the hard way that I am part of the population that is highly intolerant to natural fragrance (I had an identical reaction to a Pacifica sunscreen spray that has only "natural/clean essential oil" ingredients and fragrance or/ and to skin contact with birch sap (as a precaution I will simply assume I am allergic to keep my skin safe until I can get medically tested). So this lotion is definitely not sensitive, reactive skin friendly as I'm sure the natural fragrance components of this lotion wi

This was my first COSRX purchase and I really wanted to like this! I was going through a terrible breakout and I bought this in hopes that it would calm my red, irritated skin. It is very cooling and it has a nice scent, but it didn't help.. I think it further aggravated my breakout.

I break out pretty easily so I'm cautious trying out new lotions. This one did an amazing job leaving my skin hydrated and not feeling slick/oily afterwards. I love how glowy my skin looks. It does have a scent (very wooodsy, due to the sap) so if you don't do well with scents it might not work best for you.
it smells so good! the formula is really nice. my skin feels moisturized and soft after using. worth it
I have never found a better moisturizer for cold weather and wind! I work outside a lot, and play outside even more. This is extremely hydrating and smells amazing.

excited ulta added it finally! it's one of my holy grails and it's super refreshing and lightweight (perfect for under makeup!) it has a light minty smell which adds a cooling effect. def recommend for the more normal/oily skin girlies!

avis.titre: I have been waiting for Ulta to add this!
avis.texte: This is my holy grail lotion. It hydrates my skin without making it oily and just cools and calms my skin. There is an almost herbal smell to it but I love it. I usually order mine from asian beauty sites but will definitely start buying from Ulta when they stock it! For me, this lotion is the best out of all products that COSRX offers.
Love this stuff. Makes my skin feel moisturized but not heavy. FYI the oil free doesn't mean essential oil free it means it won't make your skin oily for all the confused out there.

This is my favorite daily moisturizer. Its lightweight but oh so hydrating, I've been very impressed. My dry skin seems to never look good in the winter no matter what I do but this has saved me. Looks great under makeup and keeps me hydrated all day. The smell is pine/minty, it threw me off at first but I love it now, doesn't last at all after application. 10/10

I have oily/combination skin that is acne prone and this moisturizer is incredible! It's not greasy at all and makes my skin feel super soft and supple. It even looks more clear! Will definitely be repurchasing this.
this keeps my skin so soft and smooth. I love it. Definitely my new go to moisturizer. Only 5 stars though because the smell isn't the best but I can get over it for the amazing effects.

such a good scent, reminds me of tea tree oil/pine trees. it feels icy cool on my skin and I use this with a retinoid every other night and the cosrx hydrating toner. my fine wrinkles and lines are less and my skin stays hydrated literally all day/thru out the night. so glad I gave this one a chance!! for me it's like.. icy cool minty goodness in a bottle lol

I do think this was effective for my skin type. It's VERY light, and gel-like substance but not sticky residue. Literally pea size amounts (one pump) does it and moisturizes well. I've had this since July since and it's looking like this bottle will last me quite some time. I do tone after cleansing so this may make a difference on how your face will feel. I utilize Glow Recipe Watermelon toner with it and the combo together is great! The lotion could be used all year long but I think it's better during summer with it being so lightweight. Scent wise, it reminds me of a can of Sprite drink but it's goes away in few seconds after application.

avis.titre: One of the Best Moisturizing Lotion!
avis.texte: I've used this for 2 years now, and I could say this is one is in for my Holy Grail. The smell is nice, it's not thick at all, it defines moisturizes my skin, especially on Winter. I get dry skin so bad, but this product really helped my skin kept moisturized on all year long!

I have an oily t-zone and drier in other areas of my face. This is a perfect very light gel moisturizer if you have a similar skin type. I also am prone to acne so this has helped too with the hyaluronic acid. It is a gel so it does absorb quickly and might feel a little sticky afterwards but nothing concerning in my opinion. Overall, would use for summer day. Have been trying to find something lightweight for combo skin like mine and so far this one works great!

It was difficult to find a face lotion that would not break me out because I tried cerave, First aid and it did break me out, I have my T- zone Oily and the rest of my face dry, I work in a health care clinic for 8 hours and I can tell for that my face with the mask on has not break out or be that oily that is with others face cream, I'm going to buy a second one with the snail essence
My go-to daytime moisturizer. It has a wonderful astringent scent, almost like pine or mint. Light texture that's absorbed quickly without stickiness. Gentle enough to calm my skin when needed.
I struggle with sensitive acne prone skin of color and I absolutely love this moisturizer! It gets the job done without being too much. Glides on smooth and smells great.

I bought this moisturizer a few months ago because I wanted something calming, light, non comodogenic, hydrating, affordable, and with aesthetically pleasing & functional packaging. I have very sensitive, acne prone skin that gets extremely irritated by BHAs and most AHAs, and past "sensitive skin" moisturizers have never performed very well when irritation would flare up. This lotion however, performs Perfectly. The few times I have been overzealous in exfoliating over the past few months, this product has calmed down the inflammation within about 15 seconds, and has never reacted poorly when combined with other products. The texture is light, and never leaves my face sticky. I've also only used about 20% of the bottle in 3 months, so a little goes a long way. My skin hasn't felt tight/dry in months, and the product absorbs well. The packaging is also great; I don't like moisturizers in tubs or tubes because the likelihood of contaminating the product during use is so much higher, so the pump on this lotion is a plus. And one final pro - CosRX doesn't test on animals! I will literally never purchase a different mositurizer again.

This is one of COSRX's best products, period. I have combination skin (oily T-zone in the summer, dry cheeks in the winter), and this is my go-to moisturizer for the warmer months, although I don't mind using it year-round. It applies smoothly and feels immediately soothing on your skin which, combined with the scent, makes you FEEL like you're doing self-care.

avis.titre: I will go down with this ship
avis.texte: I have found my new holy grain daily moisturizer. It's light but still makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. I love COSRx over all but this might be my new favorite product.

avis.titre: This is the one moisturizer I continue to buy !
avis.texte: I have sensitive and dry skin so this moisturizer doesn't make my face react and turn red but also it keep my face hydrated all day. It's the only moisturizer I keep using consistently!

I have oily but dehydrated skin, and upright dry around my cheeks. I've been on the search for a moisturizer than would hydrate my skin but not leave me greasy. I read the reviews for this and I thought it would work well for the issue. This seemed to do wonders for other people but It was mediocre for me. It provided light hydration but not enough for my skin, and on top of that it never truly absorbs into my skin. My skin feels tacky for an hour or two after applying, which leads to pilling when I apply sunscreen. My skin didn't react negatively to it though, and I'm almost done with the bottle. I'm hoping it will fare better in the summertime.

avis.titre: Product ok but not worth keeping
avis.texte: I was excited to try some Korean skincare products as I've heard great things especially from this brand but this product was not one I could get used to using. This product is both sticky and light, I felt that after applying this to my sort of combination skin - where I am usually dry it stayed dry and my more oily areas became a little irritated (got little bumps, which is not normal for me). Wasn't good for my skin type and I don't typically react so sensitively to products. If I spread it on evenly to my face some parts would end up itchy and some would end up sticky. It's a no from me.

avis.titre: HOLY GRAIL night moisturizer for summer!!!
avis.texte: FINALLY I have found my holy grail night time moisturizer for the summer! I live in a hot/humid desert climate, so in the spring/summertime my skin is oily and breakout prone (always sweating in 100+ degree weather). This moisturizer has been the only one I've ever tried that hasn't caused "purging", and I literally use two small pumps and my whole face is moisturized!! I think a lot of the bad reviews are caused by people using too much. Birch sap is also great for reducing inflammation/redness. My skin is perfectly hydrated and calmed. Not to mention it smells so calming and herbal. Thank you COSRX. Time to go buy your whole line of products lol. 10/10

avis.titre: Not for sensitive, acne prone skin
avis.texte: This says Oil-Free but the Lemon Oil and Tea Tree Oil are so strong the smell is overwhelming. After the first day the moisturizer felt really lightweight and not greasy. It has a light gel consistency. The 2nd day however my skin completely broke out all over my cheeks and nose. 2 big red pimples formed under my skin and hurt. This was the only product I added to my skin care. Which sucks because CORSX has never failed me with their other products. I'm really sad about it because I can't even use it and I definitely won't be repurchasing.
Loved this moisturizer. It does keep my face from getting dry.
Giving it 4 out of 5 stars because it's only been a couple of days but my skin loves it! It's light but it does the job without leaving your skin dry.

avis.titre: Do yourself a favor, buy it!
avis.texte: I've been using this for 3 years now. Waaay before influencers even knew the brand. The is the best moisturizer for combination to dry skin that is also acne prone. I use this with a couple drops of rose hip oil morning and night. When I started using this I had bad acne, 3 years later I only get few bumps around my period. Seriously, stick with it, it will never let you down. Also I've lived in incredibly dry & humid places with this product, always worked flawlessly.

I use this during the day. I'm picky about lotions I use before makeup because I hate when moisturizers ruin the way my makeup goes on. This one is perfect because it doesn't leave any weird residue and I can apply makeup afterward as usual. The bottle also lasted me a long time so it's a good value. The lotion is gentle and effective too. I bought it again and will probably continue to buy for as long as it exists.

This moisturizer is amazing!!! I find the scent very relaxing, like I'm in a forest :) Much nicer smell than moisturizers with heavy perfumes,, this smells so natural. Feels so nice when you put it on, feels cool on the skin and after it absorbs it leaves my skin feeling so soft!!! I haven't experienced any irritation whatsoever! I'll definitely be stocking up on this!

avis.titre: An absolute must have for oily skin
avis.texte: This moisturizer is the best one I've ever used. The fragrance is refreshing and light, not fake or intense. In the winter my skin is oily but also dry in some parts, this moisturizer saves me. A forever purchase

avis.titre: Part of my new stay at home skincare routine
avis.texte: I have been using my at home time to do a more elaborate,daily skin care routine. I use a toner (Pixi),a serum (Peach&Lily) with some Vit C powder (The Ordinary) mixed in,and the moisturizer riser I had was just TOO much after this...I could feel it on my skin,which drove me crazy. More than once I washed my face midday to get rid of the feeling. I ordered this because of the gel formula,and the oil free factor to matte down the serum. VERY happy with this. Lovely,lightweight,with a matte finish. Might serve as a good primer,but haven't tried that yet. It plays well with my other products and kicked my skin up a notch! Not expensive at all for the amount you get. Slight, but clean,natural scent..slightly pine.
This is sooooo good. It helps my skin be clear & smells like a mix of marshmallows & trees, which totally fits the natural ingredients.

I use this when I get out of the shower. The hydration is out of this world, it lasts all day. I have noticed significant improvement in my skin since using this moisturizer. I break out hardly ever and my skin is never dry or too oily. I even have my 15 year old son using this as well!

I'm seriously obsessed with this product! I have very dry, acne prone skin and this stuff does it for me! It has made washing my face one of my favorite parts of the day! A total game changer! I like that it isn't a super thick moisturizer but it does the job of a thick moisturizer! I will forever be a fan!

avis.titre: My go-to for about the last 3 years
avis.texte: I've been using this lotion for the last 3 ish years. I have combination skin that break outs out easily, but this lotion has been so gentle on my skin. It's light and absorbs pretty easily. It doesn't leave a greasyness behind. However, it probably isn't the most moisturizing lotion out there. It also has a bit of a tea tree oil scent to it, so if you don't like that this won't be for you.

Decided to try this after using & falling in love with COSRX's good morning cleanser. I have slightly sensitive oily to combination skin & this does it for me! My boyfriend, who has very oily skin, also uses this daily. We use a combination of COSRX's products (hylauronic essence, AHA/BHA toner) & our oil production is @ an all time low, for both of us. On the second tube & still loving it! :o)
Hurt when I put it on wasn't sure if it was this but I tested one half of my face and ouchie I have very sensitive skint
I really wanted to love this product but I just couldn't get it to not feel sticky/tacky.
I enjoy using this, although I don't use it everyday. I like the tea tree smell it calms my skin, and I've see improvement in my skin texture/pore clogging.

I originally got the sample/travel size set of this and I went out two days later to purchase the full size for this product. I love the smell and I love the way it makes my skin feel. It's a very light moisturizer so I actually use it as an emulsion. It's the last step in my morning routine (not counting sun cream), and the step before my thicker moisturizer in my night routine. This is another win in my book from COSRX, I might change around my moisturizer but I definitely think this is my keeper for my emulsion. I have oily, acne-prone and sensitive skin and this has worked great for me. I didn't have a skin purge with it either which is always a plus!

I used to buy this for myself when my skin was very oily during the summer in my teens. Nowadays, I need something heavier, but will still use this as long as I layer another moisturizer on top. My boyfriend loves this stuff for his oily skin. It's great because of how fast it sinks in! Very soothing and never irritating.

It contains 70% Birch sap, a powerhouse ingredient for calming and treating sensitive, irritated, or freshly exfoliated skin. If you've ever experienced dryness due to acne medication, winter weather, or natural sensitivity, this is the cream for you. It quenches dry skin with zero greasy residue and calms acne-prone skin without causing breakouts. Win-win.
This product stayed too tacky for my skin.It probably would do better with drier skin types.It smells good.

After watching many influencers rating this product, I decided to buy my first moisturizer from cosrx. As I began breaking into the skincare industry, I didn't think my skincare routine would turn into a complete nightmare after using this moisturizer for around 6 months. After using my Good Morning cleanser from the same brand, putting this moisturizer on would make my skin shiny and greasy, something I didn't expect from a moisturizer. What's worse is that throughout the hot and humid Houston day, my skin would often get oily, whether I was inside most of the time, or outside (which made the oiliness worsen). After researching a little more, I decided to invest in a different moisturizer, which didn't give me any reactions. Although giving it two stars may seem extreme, this product did not do me wonders.

Noticed my skin getting warm and a bit dry the days after using the product! Although it has birch sap (which contains niacinamide, one of my favorite non irritating ingredients) it still stung my face! Nothing mayor but just mildly uncomfortable!

avis.titre: Great for retaining Moisture, Would Buy Again
avis.texte: Stumbled upon this when I was on a search for a new moisturizer around a month to two months ago. The moisturizer I had been using just wasn't cutting it, i was struggling with quite a bit of sensitivity and my skin just wasn't as great as it has been(I typically have normal skin and some sensitivity ). So after a small patch test and wondering around the store for maybe twenty minutes with no reaction and part of my skin feeling like velvet, I went ahead and made the purchase. It's definitely different from your typical "lotion" moisturizer, I'd say it's more gel-like. After application skin does feel a little sticky for maybe a minute or two but once it's absorb fully it feels like a dream(pat your skin gently for it to absorb better), my skin stays hydrated through out the day and looks a bit brighter, under my eyes which had been a problem area for me since which feels like the begginning of time have never looked better. The scent is nice and not too strong, a light lemon smell. And a little goes a long way, I've used maybe a little over a quarter of it since I bought it.. Be careful of applying too much (I do around 3-3.5 pumps), I mean your skin can only absorb so much after all. Haven't really tried it with make-up on but I don't think it'll be a problem if you let it absorb fully before applying any.
Great for rosacea < 3 I'm buying a 2nd bottle and that is really not like me.

I have used this product for over a week and my skin looks amazing. My skin glows and it looks amazing. I have very oily and sensitive skin and this stuff is like gold.My make up stays on all day with using this moisturizer. I dont need to blot my skin or do any touch ups during the day my make up looks fresh and I dont look like I have an oil slick on my face. The price is amazing as well. I will never be without this product....you need to try it you wont be disappointed...

I really like how lightweight but hydrating this is. My skin type is oily, but often gets dehydrated (not to be confused with dry.) I like that this has hyaluronic acid to get my skin moisturized without clogging pores. I see many reviewers saying it's not truly oil free, but the oils included are tea tree and lemon, which are essential oils rather than something greasy like coconut oil or olive oil. Tea tree is likely included since it's antibacterial/antimicrobial, and lemon can help lighten acne scars, and I personally like their inclusion, but I know some people can be sensitive to them, so patch test first if possible. Overall, I find it to be a good gel-cream for acne-prone, oily skin and worth a try.

there are essential oils in this which are NOT good for your skin. they often cause irritation and burning. just because it's natural doesn't mean it's good. I have oily skin and I felt like it wasn't truly a "lotion" it's basically a gel moisturizer that made my face burn.

This moisturizer made my skin look dull and caused me to breakout. After I stopped using this, someone I work with actually asked what I changed in my skincare because my skin was looking so much healthier and glowy. All I did was take this moisturizer out and go back to my normal one. This just didnt work for me, but I love every other Cosrx product I have ever tried! This one was just a pass.
I was looking for a summer moisturizer, and was hoping this would fit the bill. Unfortunately, this felt very greasy and made my skin look and feel oily and shiny. Pass.

I have very sensitive and oily skin, so there are a lot of products that cause breakouts for me. I have been using this for about a month and I love it. I haven't had any breakouts cause by it. I have found that patting it into your skin helps to absorb more quickly, just like the directions say. I think people with oily/combo skin would love this. People with more sensitive skin may want to go in store and check out their testers first.

Combo skin girls rejoice! My constant struggle with moisturizers is that if I buy a lightweight one, it doesn't hydrate my dryness enough, and doesn't make much of a different.. but if I buy a heavy one it weighs down my skin and makes it oily/greasy. I've tried so many moisturizers trying to win that battle. This moisturizer fixes all of that!! It's perfect for combo skin. Exactly what I needed! I won't use any other moisturizer from now on. Definitely give this a try!👌🏼
A nice lightweight moisturizer, probably suitable for someone with combo to oily skin. Did not provide enough hydration for me personally, and seemed to irritate my skin... will probably return!

This lotion is very lightweight and absorbs well. I find it perfect for warmer weather. The scent of birth sap brings out childhood memories. I enjoy it though it may not be a universally liked scent. The bottle is worth a special mentioning: it is well designed, made of a contemporary looking material and is translucent to easily track the amount of the product.
I'm new to skin care and was a bit nervous trying this product. This product makes my skin feel the softest it's felt in years! I use it every day and haven't had any negative reactions.

I have seborrheic dermatitis and have tried everything from clinique to estee lauter. Nothing works like this stuff. Calms my affected areas without irritation. Somewhat of a gel like consistency. Best moisterizer.

I love COSRX! I have sensitized skin, but I've yet to react to any of their moisturizers or overnight masks. If you're looking for an oil-free moisturizer, this is the one. FWIW, the "oils" listed in this product are "essential oils", which is a misnomer since they're actually concentrated, highly fragrant, volatile, & non-oily plant extracts. They won't clog your pores, but they can cause skin reactions and irritation, so patch test first to be safe.

This was recommended to me for my dry skin by the esthetician at my local Ulta. I live where the winters are dry, over the past week this has helped my skin feel less dry. I feel like I will continue to see improvement. Just don't apply near your lips - mine have not reacted well.

I love this stuff. I've been using it for about 4 months and will repurchase once my bottle runs out (which it still hasn't even though I use this twice a day- THAT is how much product is in this). I use this as the final step in my skin care routine and find that it is very moisturizing. It doesn't absorb as fast as other moisturizers I've used, but I can't say the amount of time it takes bothers me. I've had no issues putting makeup on over it. It's now a staple in my routine.
Love this for my oily skin. It's a great moisturizer and doesn't break me out.

avis.titre: Only Lotion to Not Break Me Out
avis.texte: As the title says. My skin hates lotions of any kind, so I usually resort to lots of serum layers to keep my skin moisturized. Tried this on a whim because tea tree is good for breakouts, of which I have many. Best decision I ever made, this stuff reduces the sheer amount of pimples I get, hormonal acne notwithstanding. Keeps my skin very moisturized but never oily. I have normal/dry/sensitive skin that has a hard time absorbing products but this just sinks right in. Two pumps on my face and on on the neck is plenty for now, but when it starts snowing I can see myself doing another layer. Have been using this moisturizer for about 8 months now too, so I have thoroughly tested it. Overall, 10/10 highly recommended for troubled skin.

avis.titre: Horrible.  Oil ingredients made my skin break out
avis.texte: Uggg. Where to begin. Greasy, heavy, doesnt absorb into skin, makeup application is impossible on top of this product, and contains oils despite the bottle saying oil free. This is misleading and mislabeled branding period. Oil free means free of oils which this product is not. Ingredients listed for this product on Ulta and on the manufacturer website include the following: Citrus Medica Limonum (Lemon) Peel Oil, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil. All the money I spend on dermatologist visits and told to only use oil free products on my skin, I was irate to purchase this product because it was labeled "oil free" only to breakout severely and notice the ingredients contain oils. Shame on you,,,

In response to a previous comment that "they are not referring to essential oils" when claiming to be oil free. I laughed when I read this. oil free means free of oil.... Period. I didn't see any other "oil free" products list any type of oils (essential oil or any other oil) in their ingredients. Why? Because they are really oil free, which means free of oils,

I've only been using the moisturizer for about a month now, but I don't plan on switching any time soon. I've struggled for a long time to find a good moisturizer as I have combination oily dehydrated skin that's also acne prone and sensitive (so much 😥). This helps to hydrate my skin and lock in my essence and serum steps. My skin has been a bit less oily since using this as well, and a lot of my clogged pores have cleared up (not sure if it's this but nothing else in my routine has changed). This is even hydrating enough to use during the winter so far for me and I have little to no dry peeling skin in the mornings which used to be very common for me. I recommend trying out this product if you have oily or acne prone skin especially, as always make sure to spot test just in case your skin is reactive to this!

I love this moisturizer! I've been using it for at least two years now and it's so moisturizing and has a light, pleasant scent which I appreciate because most scented products give me a headache. I have chronically dry skin to the point where it flakes if I rub it too hard and this really helps to keep it hydrated. I use this in combination with the cosrx snail essence and they are the only products that keep my skin hydrated throughout the day.

I felt compelled to write this review on account of another reviewer's misunderstanding of oils. When a product is "oil free" they are not referring to essential oils such as tea tree oil or lemon peel oil but to carrier oils. This product is indeed oil free.

avis.titre: NOT OIL FREE.  READ INGREDIENTS. BUYER BEWARE!!!
avis.texte: Product is not oil free!!! Read the ingredients. Contains lemon peel oil and tea tree oil.

I use this product in the morning as it doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. I would recommend using it in the hotter/ humid months as it is not moisturizing enough for the winter. Or if using in the winter, mix with an oil for better moisturization. After my morning routine, I apply this and it leaves my skin feeling great. It is lightweight and absorbs quickly. It moisturizes enough to where I don't get as oily throughout the day. My makeup applies smoothly over it. I personally do not use it at night because I prefer to be a bit more moisturized at night.
I use this as my day moisturizer! This does smell a bit strong but the gel itself absorbs nicely into my skin. It leaves no sticky residue and makes my skin feel very smooth.

This moisturizer has a natural tea tree decent and it's very lightweight but very moisturizing! The moisture stays on your skin even after you run it in. However, it is not deeply moisturized. Good for daily use.
I use many of Cosrx product and none of them have smell. I hadnt ever used this moisturizer before and honest probably won't purchase again because of the smell. Very strong cleaner fluid like smell.
I love this for when I need a lightweight moisturizer. It absorbs quickly and doesn't make my skin feel oily. I've repurchased this 3 times now.

I've been using this for 2 months now and it's great, but right now my skin needs more hydration and this isn't giving it enough. I have combination skin and dehydrated oily skin at the moment. This is overall a great moisturizer for oily skin types and didn't break me out at all with my acne prone skin. But I will start using something else to hydrate my skin more and may come back to this in the warmer months.
This absorbs well into skin and has a lovely smell. Two pumps is all I need. I have normal to oily skin. I'm stocking up on product as it tends to be out of stock regularly.

Cosrx is killing the game for skincare for me right now. I'm loving this one for the hotter summer weather. Super lightweight and layers well with my other skincare! It's full of great hydrating ingredients and I love the smell of birch juice! Or also doesn't make me look super oily at the end of the day. The pump is also super convenient because I tend to use too much moisturizer. 2 pumps is enough for my face! Definitely recommend as a staple moisturizer:)
I've loved Cosrx way before they came into Ulta and boy am I glad they did! Doesn't make me oily, smoothed my dry patches and makes my skin feel nice. I use it with the snail essence .

I have very oily skin and I use this as a daytime moisturizer with SPF on top, and it works great for me. It has a lovely scent that's hard to describe, but it's not overpowering (probably the birch sap that's in this product). It doesn't feel heavy or greasy at all, either--it absorbs into the skin quite nicely. If you have really dry skin or your skin tends to get dry during certain months of the year, this might not be enough for you. Otherwise, I really have nothing bad to say about this product; I highly recommend this to anyone with a skin type similar to mine.
